summary_1line: A father urges his son to pursue righteousness and detachment before death, stressing karma, impermanence, and the quest for emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Time is imagined as a cosmic cook boiling all creatures in a vast cauldron, with the sun as fire and days and nights as fuel.
Relatives carry a lifeless body to the cremation ground, place it upon the funeral pyre, and then quietly depart back to their lives.
Suka respectfully leaves his father Vyasa and sets out alone into the wilderness to find a teacher of emancipation.
